notes.text: The handwritten sheet contains the heading Cor, its body and two-inclusion display, an oblique marginal reformulation, a proof, and the underlined heading Déf with a long left emphasis rule. No authorial date or separate authorial page number is visible. The light pencil 36 is retained only as archive numbering. H’s page{36} convention refers to the archive’s page unit.

At the opening, Card is followed by visibly empty braces and =4. The words et and the two inequalities are raised above the line and attached after that comma by a long curve. The display label is (*); its point is present far to the right of the second row. No extra omission is inferred from H’s placement of that terminal point.

The margin begins “Sous forme :”. It uses the written abbreviated group “il f et s.” and a raised, still uncertain “mutlt.”. The words “strictes” and the fourth low index remain uncertain; the parenthesized asterisk is resolved from its curved boundaries and crossed centre. The four-member mathematical list did not supply its unresolved last index.

The proof begins “En effet” and contains the literal two-bar abbreviation “de =”. Its remaining task is introduced by the author’s own wording “Il reste à voir”. Later it cites “le diagramme (14)” and ends “ce que l’on a exclu”. These are source statements; no independent proof check of the inclusions or of diagram (14) was performed.

The proof’s corrections include a cancelled two-Sigma starter, a possible earlier upright in the later target capital, a cancelled cela, the raised la première p.ex., the live signifierait que, a separately crossed Sigma12 simeq Sigma1-minus, and a short cancelled connective tentatively d’où. The curved insertion leader above signifierait was distinguished from the straight cancellation through the equation by its route through the upper rather than the body strokes.

The second Sigma after puisque has an attached downward foot and no separately readable numeral; bare Sigma is first. Its high sign has a cap and a downward stem, so top is first and plus remains an alternative. The role of the term in the surrounding list was not used to replace those visible features.

The definition’s repeated written word is panachées. The full raised phrase “si elles sont non panachées, et” is interlinear, as H’s note acknowledges. A single live l in les is shared with the compressed revised ending; it is not duplicated. The terminal point in et. and the two curved marks before de plus are retained. The final display bears (21), the word propres underlined, and the E1/E2 inequalities.

The final parenthetic reads “on dit donc que”; its d has a distinct tall loop. Pi is read from the common cap and descending stems. First-page case, the R-like curl in the definition’s second Pi, and the compressed first low suffix in (21) remain editorial uncertainties. No mathematical identification of the named objects was used to decide those letterforms.

H’s explicit notes about the top insertion, the interlinear la première p.ex., the definition addition, and the left rule were read. Those acknowledged states create no new collation difference by themselves. H’s use of emph for the author’s emphasis is treated as its declared convention. The a in a pas still lies outside H’s encoded emphasis and is an actual scope difference.

No authored question mark, request for verification, or date was observed on this sheet. All unsure marks in reading.tex are editorial accounts of the observed ink. The source’s cancelled and uncertain wording is retained without conjectures, supplementary lemmas, or conditional theorems.

workflow_feedback.crop_policy: Each still-open locus was read from one enhanced crop. Coherent groups share a crop. No target was recropped or re-enlarged after a decision. All output crop widths are 3000 pixels.
workflow_feedback.rotation: The complete slanted marginal note was rotated clockwise by 44 degrees within its one crop operation; threshold-based trimming removed outer white padding. Unrelated body context remains at the rotated lower/right edge.
clipping: Crop 08 cuts the extreme bottom of the long que descender. The complete half b had included its available extent; the whole-image finding bounds extend to y=1558. The word was settled and not recropped.
Crops 11 and 13 truncate portions of already-read interlinear/context letters at their edges; the targeted heading, Pi pair and les are complete.
The final line reaches the source photograph’s lower paper edge. Crop 15 includes that source edge and its black border; the low que descender is source-clipped there.
workflow_feedback.storage: All writes were confined to work/readers/scan037/R3/. reading.tex was completed and saved before return.json composition.
workflow_feedback.graphic_classification: There is no independent pictorial drawing or arrow diagram on this sheet. The long vertical mark is a text-emphasis rule, represented beside the definition; the brace belongs to the inclusion display.
workflow_feedback.verification: The JSON schema, allowed inventory values, crop bounds and coverage of all 21 C doubt identifiers are checked by a local non-compiling script. No mathematical proof check is claimed.
workflow_feedback.exact_witness_string_check: Every non-absent c and h field was verified as an exact substring of its supplied witness. All 21 C doubt IDs are covered once; 8 resolved, 13 retained.
